multiple_sensors.colorGuidance: For line-following over tape: Red r/sum > 0.55; Green g/sum > 0.325 AND r/sum < 0.45 AND g > 1.3*b; Blue b/sum > 0.245 AND r/sum < 0.45; otherwise Floor. Handle sum=0 separately. These are local measured starting thresholds, not universal calibration.
